# FunkYouSHiFT

Official site: https://www.funkyoushift.com/

FunkYouSHiFT is a Borderlands community hub for Discord help, modding basics, builds, tools, resources, streams, giveaways, and merch.

Primary pages:
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modding.html — main modding guide and modded gear landing page
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-builds.html — builds, planner, creator resources, and Discord feedback
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-resources.html — toolbox with mod databases, editors, trainers, GenieBot, Maxroll, and creator links
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-discord.html — Discord community landing page

Merged/redirected pages:
- borderlands-modded-weapons.html redirects to borderlands-modding.html
- borderlands-trading.html redirects to borderlands-discord.html
- borderlands-build-videos.html redirects to borderlands-builds.html

Discord: https://discord.com/servers/funk-s-borderlands-trading-hub-997021744764289084
Version: 4.0.0
